# 2 Baruch Chapter 82 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Baruch's Letters

---

**1** "Do not grieve therefore concerning the things which have befallen you; for now the time of completion approaches, and the fullness of the ages is near to come."

**2** "Do not be troubled because of the misfortunes that have come upon Israel; for the salvation of Israel draws near, and the end of the tribulation."

**3** "Do not be afraid, for the Mighty One will deliver you; and do not be afraid of your enemies, for the hour of your redemption approaches."

**4** "For the time is near that is appointed, and the day of judgment is at hand, and the end of the ages will come."

**5** "For all evil will be rooted out, and all wickedness will be swept away; and the covenant of the Mighty One will stand forever."

**6** "And those who have been found worthy of the kingdom will inherit it; and those who have been found righteous will be exalted; and those who have been found wicked will be condemned."

**7** "And those who have known the law will be justified; and those who have not known it will receive what they deserve."

**8** "And now remember your fathers who are dead; and hold fast to the covenant which they established with the Mighty One; and remember the works of the fathers."

**9** "For the name of your fathers will live forever and ever; and God will not forget the name of Israel; and the seed of Jacob will not be rooted out."

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Paragraph divisions follow the sense units of the source.*
